verses.greek: Πᾶσα ψυχὴ ἐξουσίαις ὑπερεχούσαις ὑποτασσέσθω, οὐ γὰρ ἔστιν ἐξουσία εἰ μὴ ὑπὸ θεοῦ, αἱ δὲ οὖσαι ὑπὸ θεοῦ τεταγμέναι εἰσίν.
verses.literal: Every soul to the authorities being above him should be subject. Not for there is authority only except by God those however existing by God instituted are.
verses.dgt: Let every soul be subject to governing authorities. For there is no authority except from God, and those that exist have been appointed by God.

verses.greek: ὥστε ὁ ἀντιτασσόμενος τῇ ἐξουσίᾳ τῇ τοῦ θεοῦ διαταγῇ ἀνθέστηκεν, οἱ δὲ ἀνθεστηκότες ἑαυτοῖς κρίμα λήμψονται.
verses.literal: Therefore the one resisting the authority the the of God ordinance has resisted those now having resisted upon themselves judgment will bring.
verses.dgt: Therefore the one who resists the authority has opposed the arrangement of God, and those who oppose will receive judgment on themselves.

verses.greek: οἱ γὰρ ἄρχοντες οὐκ εἰσὶν φόβος τῷ ἀγαθῷ ἔργῳ ἀλλὰ τῷ κακῷ. θέλεις δὲ μὴ φοβεῖσθαι τὴν ἐξουσίαν; τὸ ἀγαθὸν ποίει, καὶ ἕξεις ἔπαινον ἐξ αὐτῆς·
verses.literal: The for rulers not are a terror to the good work but to the evil. Do you desire now not to fear the authority? The good do perform and you will have praise from him
verses.dgt: For rulers are not a fear to good work but to evil. And do you wish not to fear the authority? Do good, and you will have praise from it,

verses.greek: θεοῦ γὰρ διάκονός ἐστιν σοὶ εἰς τὸ ἀγαθόν. ἐὰν δὲ τὸ κακὸν ποιῇς, φοβοῦ· οὐ γὰρ εἰκῇ τὴν μάχαιραν φορεῖ· θεοῦ γὰρ διάκονός ἐστιν, ἔκδικος εἰς ὀργὴν τῷ τὸ κακὸν πράσσοντι.
verses.literal: Of God for servant he is to you for the good. If however the evil you shall do do be afraid not for in vain the sword he bears. of God for a servant He is an avenger for wrath to the one the evil doing.
verses.dgt: for it is God’s servant to you for good. But if you do evil, be afraid, for it does not bear the sword in vain; for it is God’s servant, an avenger for wrath against the one who practices evil.

verses.greek: διὸ ἀνάγκη ὑποτάσσεσθαι, οὐ μόνον διὰ τὴν ὀργὴν ἀλλὰ καὶ διὰ τὴν συνείδησιν,
verses.literal: Therefore necessary it is to be subject not only on account of the wrath but also on account of the conscience.
verses.dgt: Therefore it is necessary to be subject, not only because of wrath but also because of conscience.

verses.greek: διὰ τοῦτο γὰρ καὶ φόρους τελεῖτε, λειτουργοὶ γὰρ θεοῦ εἰσιν εἰς αὐτὸ τοῦτο προσκαρτεροῦντες.
verses.literal: Because of this for also taxes pay you servants for of God they are upon this very thing attending continually.
verses.dgt: For because of this you also pay taxes, for they are servants of God attending continually to this very thing.

verses.greek: ἀπόδοτε πᾶσι τὰς ὀφειλάς, τῷ τὸν φόρον τὸν φόρον, τῷ τὸ τέλος τὸ τέλος, τῷ τὸν φόβον τὸν φόβον, τῷ τὴν τιμὴν τὴν τιμήν.
verses.literal: do render to all their dues to whom the tax the tax to whom the revenue the revenue to whom the respect the respect to whom the honor the honor.
verses.dgt: Give to all what is owed: tax to whom tax is due, revenue to whom revenue, fear to whom fear, honor to whom honor.

verses.greek: Μηδενὶ μηδὲν ὀφείλετε, εἰ μὴ τὸ ἀλλήλους ἀγαπᾶν· ὁ γὰρ ἀγαπῶν τὸν ἕτερον νόμον πεπλήρωκεν.
verses.literal: To no one nothing do owe only except the one another to love the one for loving the other the Law has fulfilled
verses.dgt: Owe nothing to anyone except to love one another, for the one who loves the other has fulfilled law.

verses.greek: τὸ γάρ· Οὐ μοιχεύσεις, Οὐ φονεύσεις, Οὐ κλέψεις, Οὐκ ἐπιθυμήσεις, καὶ εἴ τις ἑτέρα ἐντολή, ἐν τῷ λόγῳ τούτῳ ἀνακεφαλαιοῦται, ἐν τῷ· Ἀγαπήσεις τὸν πλησίον σου ὡς σεαυτόν.
verses.literal: the For Not you will commit adultery Not you will murder Not you will steal not you will covet and if any other commandment in the word this it is summed up in the saying You will love the neighbour of you as yourself.
verses.dgt: For “You shall not commit adultery, You shall not murder, You shall not steal, You shall not desire,” and if there is any other commandment, it is summed up in this word: “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”

verses.greek: ἡ ἀγάπη τῷ πλησίον κακὸν οὐκ ἐργάζεται· πλήρωμα οὖν νόμου ἡ ἀγάπη.
verses.literal: the Love to the neighbour evil not does do the fulfillment therefore of the law the love is.
verses.dgt: Love does no evil to a neighbor; therefore love is the fulfillment of law.

verses.greek: Καὶ τοῦτο εἰδότες τὸν καιρόν, ὅτι ὥρα ἤδη ὑμᾶς ἐξ ὕπνου ἐγερθῆναι, νῦν γὰρ ἐγγύτερον ἡμῶν ἡ σωτηρία ἢ ὅτε ἐπιστεύσαμεν.
verses.literal: And this knowing the time that it is the hour already for you out of sleep to awaken now for nearer is of us the salvation than when first we believed
verses.dgt: And this, knowing the time, that it is already the hour for you to awaken from sleep, for now our salvation is nearer than when we believed.

verses.greek: ἡ νὺξ προέκοψεν, ἡ δὲ ἡμέρα ἤγγικεν. ἀποβαλώμεθα οὖν τὰ ἔργα τοῦ σκότους, ἐνδυσώμεθα δὲ τὰ ὅπλα τοῦ φωτός.
verses.literal: The night is nearly over the and the day has drawn near. ἀποβαλώμεθα therefore the works the of darkness we may put on now the armor the of light.
verses.dgt: The night has advanced, and the day has drawn near. Therefore let us put away the works of darkness and put on the weapons of light.

verses.greek: ὡς ἐν ἡμέρᾳ εὐσχημόνως περιπατήσωμεν, μὴ κώμοις καὶ μέθαις, μὴ κοίταις καὶ ἀσελγείαις, μὴ ἔριδι καὶ ζήλῳ,
verses.literal: As in daytime properly we may walk not in reveling and in drinking not in sexual immorality and in sensuality not in dissension and in jealousy
verses.dgt: Let us walk properly as in the day, not in revelries and drunkenness, not in sexual immorality and sensuality, not in strife and jealousy,

verses.greek: ἀλλὰ ἐνδύσασθε τὸν κύριον Ἰησοῦν Χριστόν, καὶ τῆς σαρκὸς πρόνοιαν μὴ ποιεῖσθε εἰς ἐπιθυμίας.
verses.literal: But do put on the Lord Jesus Christ and of the flesh provision not do make for desires.
verses.dgt: but put on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make no provision for the flesh toward desires.
